download_models_cli: download Docling models to a local directory using the CLI download command
download_models_all: download all available Docling models to a specified output directory using the --all flag
download_models_selective: download specific Docling models (layout, tableformer, rapidocr) to a local directory
download_hf_models: download models from HuggingFace repositories to a local directory using the download-hf-repo command
list_available_models: list all available Docling model identifiers from the _AvailableModels enum
